ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Bid submitted and later stages need Amount, Estimated margin and Contract form.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Estimated_margin__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Contract_form__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Estimated margin and Contract form before moving to Bid submitted.
